text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security forces kill about 60 "terrorists" holed up in tunnel-hideout.
- President Liamine Zeroual to address the nation next week to set a date for the local elections and outline clemency measures.
- A bomb explosion kills a man and wounds another in Oued Yaich area, south of Algiers.
- The interior ministry ordered newly freed Abassi Madani, chief of the outlawed Islamic Salvation Front (FIS), to stay away from politics.
